formulas.formula: IF(AND(uc:UBPR9999[P0] > '2015-01-01', uc:UBPRC752[P0] = 31), cc:RCFDA8274[P0], IF(AND(uc:UBPR9999[P0] > '2015-01-01', uc:UBPRC752[P0] = 41), cc:RCONA8274[P0], IF(uc:UBPRC752[P0] = 31, cc:RCFD8274[P0], IF(uc:UBPRC752[P0] = 41, cc:RCON8274[P0], null))))
